title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Evaluators)
(1) The Minister of Justice may have the following superiors conduct service evaluations of prosecutors: [Amended on November 30, 2018.]
1. The prosecutor's superior under Article 7 (1) of the Act;
2. For a person belonging to the Ministry of Justice who concurrently holds a prosecutor position, a superior who is a prosecutor belonging to the Ministry of Justice and who directs and supervises the prosecutor's handling of duties;
3. For a prosecutor serving outside the prosecutor's affiliated prosecutors' office by reason of acting in another position or otherwise, a superior who is a prosecutor of the prosecutors' office where the prosecutor actually serves and who directs and supervises the prosecutor's handling of duties: Provided, however, that this shall not apply where, in view of the period of acting service or other circumstances, it is deemed appropriate to conduct the evaluation at the prosecutor's affiliated prosecutors' office.
(2) Where there are several service evaluators under paragraph (1), the evaluators may share evaluation duties by evaluation item or stage.
(3) The chief prosecutor of a district prosecutors' office may review service evaluation results for prosecutors belonging to branch offices under the district prosecutors' office's jurisdiction and may present opinions thereon.
